positions.as_written: Assess the limb's perfusion first, because a dislocated or reduced knee can have an arterial injury with palpable pulses.
Assess the common peroneal nerve, since it is injured in a substantial share of these patterns.
Assess rotational instability, because the posterolateral and posteromedial corners decide much of the plan.
Record the whole pattern rather than the most obvious finding.
